hero.title: 🛕 Temple Name Generator
hero.tagline: Holy sanctuaries, hidden cult fanes and lost ziggurats, each with a god of its own.

article.intro: Every temple in a fantasy world says something about the god inside it. This **temple name generator** makes temple names for D&D and fantasy writing in six styles, from sunlit sanctuaries and druid circles to cult fanes and mountain monasteries, and can tell you which invented god is worshipped there.
